notes: Conformance fixtures for scripts/skill-conformance.test.ts — shaped fake values only, never real credentials. Two scenarios cover the sign-in branches: (1) host already signed in (connected_email read from `dial doctor`), (2) not signed in → email + OTP. The `package.json` stub answers dial_ua; the `(.data|length)==0` stub (the agent-list capture's jq) answers agent_groups; `dial doctor` answers signed_in/connected_email. The scoping wires and the credential upsert run against the stubbed exec and capture nothing.
